Getting Started

Learn how to use CloakDesk to protect your blockchain privacy

Step 1

Connect Your Wallet

Connect your Ethereum wallet using WalletConnect or MetaMask. CloakDesk supports all major wallet providers.

Step 2

View Privacy Health

Get an instant analysis of your wallet&apos;s privacy exposure. See risk scores and actionable recommendations.

Step 3

Use Privacy Tools

Explore stealth routing, wallet shadowing, MPC vault, and other privacy-enhancing features.

Stealth Routing
